issues.description: OutputImageRawFrame uses image.tobytes() without converting PIL mode while declaring format='RGB'
issues.detail: Gemini-returned images may decode as RGBA, palette, or grayscale modes. Calling image.tobytes() then hardcoding format='RGB' produces buffers with wrong size/channel layout, causing corrupted or rejected video frames downstream. Fix by calling image.convert('RGB') before tobytes().

issues.description: Module-level monkey-patch of private genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE is fragile and global
issues.detail: Mutating a private google-genai attribute at import time affects every SDK consumer in the process and will silently break when the SDK renames or removes the attribute, especially given the loosened version pin (<2.0). Needs a guarded try/except, hasattr check, and an issue link tracking removal.

issues.description: Default model change from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash is a silent breaking change
issues.detail: Users relying on the implicit default get different cost, latency, thinking-budget behavior, and output characteristics. The CHANGELOG buries this under 'Changed' without a prominent migration note; it should be called out as potentially breaking or staged behind explicit opt-in.

issues.description: Image-model detection via substring 'image' in model name is brittle
issues.detail: Using `if 'image' in self._model_name` to suppress thinking budget will match any future model containing 'image' anywhere in its name and may miss image-capable models named differently. Prefer an explicit allowlist, prefix check, or capability flag.

issues.description: No error handling around PIL Image.open on inline_data bytes
issues.detail: Image.open(io.BytesIO(part.inline_data.data)) can raise UnidentifiedImageError or other PIL exceptions on malformed responses, killing the entire _process_context loop and breaking the pipeline. Wrap in try/except and log instead of aborting the conversation turn.

issues.description: Example routes image-generation model through TTS pipeline without clear image-to-transport wiring
issues.detail: 07n-interruptible-gemini-image.py sends OutputImageRawFrames through the TTS stage, but image-gen models may emit minimal text and TTS does not consume image frames. The example does not clearly document how generated images reach video_out, risking user confusion or silent drops.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees on two P0 correctness issues: OutputImageRawFrame is built from image.tobytes() without normalizing the PIL mode while declaring format='RGB' (corrupting non-RGB outputs), and a module-level monkey-patch of a private google-genai attribute (_api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE) is globally fragile, especially under the loosened SDK version pin. Secondary concerns are the silent default-model bump from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash, a brittle substring check for image models, and missing error handling around PIL decoding. The new example pipeline routes image-gen output through TTS without clearly demonstrating how images reach the transport.
